newsitem.title: CHINA: JAL, SAA plan Johannesburg/Osaka code share flights.
newsitem.headline: JAL, SAA plan Johannesburg/Osaka code share flights.

text.p: Japan Airlines (JAL) and South African Airways will start twice weekly code share passenger flights between Osaka and Johannesburg via Bangkok from October 2, a JAL statement said.
JAL will be the first Japanese airline to link the two countries and the service will be operated by a SAA Boeing 747-200 with 295 seats, 70 of them allocated to JAL, the statement added.
Departures from Osaka's Kansai airport will be on Fridays and Sundays at 19.25 returning from Johannesburg on Thursdays and Saturdays at 17.45, it said.
